properties_with_code.text: Malformed blob tx RLP must be rejected gracefully without crashing the node process.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall p2p_msg: decode_blob_tx(msg.rlp) either succeeds or raises caught exception; no unhandled crash

locations.note: Decodes blob wrapper from P2P without per-field validation; malformed RLP throws unhandled exceptions
P2P entry point; calls DecodeArrayPool with InMempoolForm; no per-tx exception isolation
One malformed tx in batch causes entire batch decode to fail; all valid txs in same message lost

properties_with_code.text: tx.BlobVersionedHashes length must equal wrapper Blobs/Commitments/Proofs length.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall blob_tx: len(tx.BlobVersionedHashes) == len(wrapper.Blobs) == len(wrapper.Commitments) == len(wrapper.Proofs)

locations.note: Two loops with mismatched bounds: first iterates blobVersionedHashes.Length (hash format check), second iterates blobs.Blobs.Length (commitment check). No length equality assertion between the two arrays.
Calls ValidateLengths (wrapper-internal only) then ValidateHashes; never cross-checks tx.BlobVersionedHashes.Length vs wrapper.Blobs.Length
Validates tx.BlobVersionedHashes count/format but has no access to wrapper; gap between this and MempoolBlobTxValidator
Checks wrapper internal consistency (Blobs==Commitments==Proofs length) but NOT vs tx.BlobVersionedHashes
